set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Artifact verification derives its expected set from the enforced publication matrix.
- Every published JVM and Scala.js POM is generated and inspected.
- Binary, source, and documentation jars exist with correct coordinates, metadata, and dependency scopes.
- Core artifacts do not leak test-only dependencies.
- Local fresh consumers resolve the exact generated candidate version.
- After 1.0 publication, MiMa immediately targets 1.0.0 and becomes required.
- A false-green verifier that inspects only a subset of published modules is impossible.
set.title: Verify every published POM, binary, source, and documentation artifact
